body_lead: Maharashtra is taking its use of AI beyond pilot projects. The state government has approved a two-year outlay of Rs 11.26 crore to deploy sovereign AI solutions from Sarvam AI across government departments. The package will include Indus, an AI workspace for around 2,500 government users, along with voice-based citizen outreach and speech technologies for the state's MahaAI platform. This proposal was cleared by a High-Power Committee headed by the chief secretary, according to a Government Resolution.
